question: Which sacrificial and sovereign epithets of the divine lord are saluted in this mantra verse?
premises: The deity is addressed as borne by sacrifice.
The deity is addressed as the staff.
The deity is addressed as the divine lord and receives repeated obeisance.
inference: The mantra offers repeated obeisance to the sacrifice-borne, staff-like divine lord.
uncertainties: The precise sense of yajña+vāhāya and daṇḍāya is uncertain
plain_english: Obeisance, obeisance to the one borne by sacrifice, the staff, the divine lord.
